import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus2022_hypertension.xlsx', sheet_name='VI', header=None)
idx_adj = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('age adjusted', case=False)].index[0]
idx_crude = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('crude', case=False)].index[0]
df_adj = df.iloc[idx_adj:idx_crude]

male_val = float(df_adj[df_adj[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Male'][2].iloc[0])
female_val = float(df_adj[df_adj[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Female'][2].iloc[0])
result = round(male_val - female_val, 1)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus2022_hypertension.xlsx', sheet_name='VI', header=None)
idx_adj = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('age adjusted', case=False)].index[0]
idx_crude = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('crude', case=False)].index[0]
df_adj = df.iloc[idx_adj:idx_crude]

races = ['White only', 'Black only', 'Asian only', 'Hispanic or Latino']
sub = df_adj[df_adj[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(races)].copy()
sub['val'] = sub[2].astype(float)
max_group = sub.loc[sub['val'].idxmax(), 0].strip()
result = 'yes' if 'Black' in max_group else 'no'
